input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent MUST NOT mention the overdue amount, EMI, loan, or debt before successful verification. After verification succeeds, the agent may disclose the debt details.
Agent calls verify_customer. If verification fails, agent MUST NOT disclose any debt information and should politely end or retry according to the configured flow.

input_sequence: I can pay the full amount this Friday.
expected_behavior: After successful authentication, agent discloses the overdue details, captures the promised payment date and amount, calls log_promise_to_pay, then calls send_payment_link and closes the call.

input_sequence: I already paid this EMI yesterday.
expected_behavior: Agent asks for payment date/mode, calls mark_disposition with status ALREADY_PAID, does not pressure the customer to pay again, and politely closes the call.

input_sequence: I cannot pay the full amount because I have financial difficulties.
expected_behavior: Agent responds empathetically, captures the hardship situation, and routes/escalates the case according to the configured hardship flow.

input_sequence: I dispute this amount. I don't think I owe this.
expected_behavior: Agent must not argue with the customer. It should acknowledge the dispute and route the case to the appropriate resolution/human-agent flow.

input_sequence: I don't want to receive any more calls.
expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges the request, calls mark_disposition with status DO_NOT_CALL, and ends the call immediately.

input_sequence: No, Rahul Sharma is not here.
expected_behavior: Agent must not reveal any debt information. It should politely ask whether Rahul Sharma is available and, if unavailable, call mark_disposition with status WRONG_PERSON and end the call.
Agent should provide limited re-prompts for no response and then end the call with an appropriate NO_RESPONSE disposition.

input_sequence: I will pay today. Please send me the payment link.
expected_behavior: After successful authentication, agent calls send_payment_link with the customer's account ID and SMS or WhatsApp channel, confirms that the payment link was sent, and closes politely.
